definitionZh: 边距顶端的 CSS 属性将边距区域设置在元素顶端. 一个正值使它离邻居更远,而负值使它更近.
sourceDefinition: The margin-top CSS property sets the margin area on the top of an element. A positive value places it farther from its neighbors, while a negative value places it closer.
